thread:
maria: FYI we got alerts from several customers that restores are failing after last-night's KMS rotation.
sec-ops-bot: [alert] snapshot-restore-error for tenant: zephyr-inc at 00:15 UTC. Error: KMS AccessDenied on Decrypt.
dave: Which CMK was rotated? @ingrid any KMS audit entries yet?
ingrid: Rotated alias: arn:cloudkms:...:key/alias/redwood/snapshots-main at 23:58 UTC. I can see a rotation event + new key version created.
sam: Did the restore process use the snapshot-service role or storage-gateway role to call KMS? We recently scoped down permissions.
maria: snapshot-service (k8s sa -> OIDC -> IAM role). We applied a tighter policy last week. I think Decrypt was removed.
dave: So restore jobs start -> KMS:Decrypt denied because policy removed access to the old key version. Combination of rotation + RBAC tighten.
ingrid: Quick evidence: CloudKMS logs show Decrypt attempts for keyVersion:v1 by role:snapshot-service -> AccessDenied.
sec-ops-bot: [note] opened incident INC-2026-191 and created a high-priority PagerDuty alert.
pagerbot: Incident INC-2026-191 acknowledged by oncall: maria.
maria: Immediate containment: reinstate kms:Decrypt for snapshot-service for the affected key version as a temporary allowance. I'll push a rollback on the RBAC change.
dave: Agreed. Also add a temporary runbook step to retry restores after granting Decrypt.
ingrid: For the short term, I'll add an explicit Allow in the key policy for principal role:snapshot-service with Resource: keyVersion arn pointing to the previous version. Policy snippet:
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": "kms:Decrypt",
  "Principal": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/snapshot-service",
  "Resource": "arn:aws:kms:...:key/<key-id>/keyVersion/<old-version>"
}
```
sam: Long-term we need the restore path to tolerate key rotations: either auto-rewrap existing DEKs to the new CMK or record a list of wrap-versions on the snapshot metadata and try each on restore.
dave: I prefer metadata approach first: add field wrap_key_versions: ["v1","v2"], and let restore attempt Decrypt with each until one succeeds. Less blast radius than mass rewrap.
ingrid: We'll also implement a rewrap background worker to progressively rewrap DEKs to current key version and emit metrics.
maria: Add a pre-rotation validator: before rotating a CMK, run a check that all snapshot-owners and snapshot-service can still Decrypt at least one recorded wrap version.
dave: Pseudo for pre-rotation check:
```
for s in snapshots:
  for v in s.wrap_key_versions:
    if kms.can_decrypt(service_role, v):
      continue to next snapshot
  fail rotation
```
sam: Also: enforce a rotation grace period where both old and new versions remain allowed for snapshot-service. Make that configurable.
ingrid: Audit changes: rotation events must include initiator, rotation_id, affected_snapshot_count, and a checksum to correlate with restore failures in logs.
maria: Post-incident action items (short): revert RBAC change, temporary allow Decrypt, implement wrap_key_versions + multi-version fallback, background rewrap worker, pre-rotation validation, rotation audit payloads, staging tests that simulate rotation+RBAC.
sam: I'll own the rewrap worker and CI staging tests. ETA: PoC in 4 days.
dave: I'll add pre-rotation gate in the UI/automation and implement grace-window logic. ETA: 48 hours.
ingrid: I'll expand rotation audit payload and run a vuln triage on snapshot-service dependencies (S3/GCS clients) that might drop KMS-context headers. Assign to @dave and @sam for patches.
sec-ops-bot: [reminder] add high-priority alert if restore_failure_rate > 0.5% within 10m after rotation.
maria: Can we add synthetic tests in staging that rotate keys and then run restore flows automatically? Catch this as part of deploy gating.
dave: Yes, add sentinel test + make pre-rotation validation run in staging for every rotation PR.
ingrid: One more note: update snapshot metadata schema to include created_by_key_version and wrap_key_versions and a small migration to backfill for snapshots created in the last 12 months.
sam: We'll also add metrics: rewrap_jobs_pending, rewrap_rate, and histogram for decrypt_latency with per-key-version tags.
maria: Good. I'll file the postmortem and link INC-2026-191. For now, follow the containment steps in the incident runbook and update this thread with progress. :white_check_mark:
dave: Thanks. Keep me posted if any restores still fail after the temporary policy is applied.
ingrid: Policy change applied for the old key version; kicking off a test restore now.
sec-ops-bot: [info] test restore SUCCESS for sample snapshot id: snap-9a2c at 00:36 UTC.
maria: Closing incident once we confirm all affected tenants can restore. Follow-ups will be in the postmortem doc assigned to security and storage teams.
